meta.scope: Integrate S212 bioRxiv v3 Figure 6 connectome-model method, reported metrics and validation boundary; preserve independent imaging/behavior endpoints.

records.title: Combining brain-wide activity imaging with electron microscopy reveals a distributed brain network for processing threatening somatosensory stimuli

searches.query: S212 Figure 6 model, comparison and reported denominators; compare with existing version 2 extraction

updates.метод: Same-specimen larval light-sheet calcium imaging and eFIB-SEM registration, followed by targeted two-photon validation and a separate rolling assay. Version 3 additionally models the larval connectome as a recurrent firing-rate network: synapse counts set connection strengths, predicted neurotransmitters set signs, and simulated Basin activation is compared with observed calcium-response valence. A null ensemble uses 1,000 out-degree-preserving shuffled networks.
updates.производительность: In one first-instar CNS, 119 of roughly 3,000 brain neurons responded to Basin activation; 25 responsive lineages and 101/119 traced neurons were reported. Separate third-instar cohorts showed reduced rolling (P=0.0037) and increased turning (P=0.025) after KC silencing during Basin activation (n=366/351; v3 Fig. 5C). Separately, v3 Figure 6 reports connectome-model AUC 0.74 (Mann-Whitney U p=0.045), response-sign accuracy 72.4%, and an out-degree-preserving-shuffle permutation p=0.025. These are author-reported within-study metrics, not reproduced or human validation.
updates.ограничения: One first-instar CNS underlies whole-brain imaging and EM registration; validation and rolling assays use other third-instar larvae. Optogenetic Basin stimulation is an experimental proxy for nociceptive input. Calcium responses, circuit anatomy and rolling are distinct endpoints; none measures subjective pain or establishes human transfer. Version 3 Figure 6 does not report the exact evaluated-neuron denominator or a train/test split in the checked text; the reported 72.4% must not be assigned the nearby 20/26 tracing denominator. The graph-null result is a fly-neuron valence comparison, not Drosophila-to-ECAP transfer or clinical SCS evidence.
